title.zh: 分析：《GENIUS法案》为三星稳定币支付铺路，将覆盖8200万美国Galaxy用户
title.en: 分析：《GENIUS法案》为三星稳定币支付铺路，将覆盖8200万美国Galaxy用户

current_state.zh: Samsung will launch zero-fee USDC cross-border transfers in Samsung Wallet for eligible US Galaxy users (~82M devices) starting the last week of October, using Solana and Sui rails with Bastion and Coinbase Prime custody, a move framed by Solana Foundation as enabled by the GENIUS Act.
current_state.en: Samsung will launch zero-fee USDC cross-border transfers in Samsung Wallet for eligible US Galaxy users (~82M devices) starting the last week of October, using Solana and Sui rails with Bastion and Coinbase Prime custody, a move framed by Solana Foundation as enabled by the GENIUS Act.
